notes_for_editor: Two listings only. Nothing was found on the build date, design, staffing or fires of an Osborne Ridge tower. The Caldwell entry is marked 'Duplicate?' by the FFLA; the two may be one tower, unresolved. The brief's point (36.85241, -82.52822) is about 1.2 km from the MountainZone ridge point (36.8568, -82.5157); the ridge is a landform, so no location correction is proposed. No access level is recorded: no source describes access. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
